description: This source file implements the Overflow64Counter class that manages a 64-bit global cycle counter using a 32-bit hardware cycle count register, handling overflows, and providing methods to update and retrieve the counter value. It includes functions for updating the counter safely within critical sections and is designed for embedded firmware that requires precise timing overflows handling.

classes.name: Overflow64Counter
classes.description: A class used for tracking a 64-bit cycle count based on a 32-bit hardware register, handling overflow detection, and providing a continuous timing counter.

methods.name: Overflow64Counter::Overflow64Counter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the high and low bits of the counter.

methods.name: updateAndSet
methods.description: Function called to atomically update the cycle counter's state, handling overflow detection.

methods.name: Overflow64Counter::update
methods.description: Method to update the internal counter with a new 32-bit value, returning the combined 64-bit count.
